title: Detecting and Mitigating Bias in LLMs through Knowledge Graph-Augmented Training

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using the Bias in Bios dataset for gender stereotype analysis, measuring changes in Demographic Parity and accuracy before and after applying Knowledge Graph-Augmented Training.
Evaluated using the ProPublica COMPAS dataset for fairness in recidivism prediction, computing changes in Equal Opportunity and overall racial bias reduction.
Evaluated using the CelebA dataset to assess fairness and biases in facial attribute classification.
